svg.title: LoRA freezes the base weight matrix and learns its update as the product of two small matrices.
svg.desc: A frozen matrix W₀ is left unchanged; two trainable matrices A and B of rank r produce a low-rank update BA, scaled by α/r, and added to W₀. The adapter has r(d_in+d_out) trainable parameters instead of d_in·d_out for that matrix — a 128× reduction at rank 16 on a 4,096-wide matrix, not the 10,000× figure reported for one specific GPT-3 175B configuration.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: LoRA freezes the base and trains a low-rank update

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Two small matrices replace one large trainable one.
